crossRefs.note: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of…
Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By…
All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people…
Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.
The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’ ”

people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: Deborah
people.line: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory over Canaanites.

people.name: Kedesh
people.line: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city of refuge in Naphtali

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
translations.bsb: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.
translations.kjv: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up
translations.asv: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh; and there went up ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
